sources.entry: Recipya - Clean, simple and powerful recipe manager your whole family will enjoy. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Go

summary.one_liner: Recipya is a self-hostable web recipe manager for storing, importing, digitizing and sharing family recipes, distributed as a Go application with Docker support.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a web app for managing favorite recipes and importing recipes from around the web. Users can digitize paper recipes and organize recipes into cookbooks. It offers migration from Mealie, Tandoor and Nextcloud Cookbook, and can convert recipes to imperial or metric units. It also calculates nutritional information automatically and offers a print view for any recipe. A screen-wake-lock option keeps the device awake while viewing a recipe, and the UI follows the system light/dark theme or one of 32 themes. The README says release builds are cross-compiled for Windows, Linux and macOS, and describes a self-update mechanism that checks GitHub releases every three days.
use_cases: migrate recipes from Mealie or Tandoor
how_to_run: git clone the repository (command given in README without URL)
Installation instructions are in the documentation's installation section
notable: Migration imports from Mealie, Tandoor and Nextcloud Cookbook
Automatic metric/imperial conversion and nutrition calculation
Choice of 32 themes with light/dark system following
Built-in self-update from GitHub releases for release builds
caveats: README warns the project is being rewritten in Rust, which is not ready for production or self-hosting
Docker update and install steps are only linked to the documentation, not given inline
Release builds are cross-compiled for Windows, Linux and macOS; no other platform support is named
